section: Iterate - feature: intent pyramid terms and format (U0)
title: Capability column next to D7; intent.md as second human-owned file
context: Product owners cannot accept a product without reading FRs and ACs; the FR is also called a capability in prompts.
decision: FR is one function; a Capability groups FRs, stored in a Capability column next to Area (D7); intent.md is the second human-owned file.
consequences: Vocabulary, schema and constitution entry exist; column, parser, gate and confirmation are later units.
rationale: Ownership stays checkable per file path; Area is rendered, Capability is stored.
rejected: Human section inside spec.md; JSON/YAML source rendered to markdown.
